sourceTitle: Salted Caramel Potted Plant Ice Cream
sourceText:
Salted Caramel Potted Plant Ice Cream
By: Blackswan
Published: Friday, December 21, 2018 - 6:50pm

Ingredients




250g Salted Caramel Ice Cream or any other flavours
6 Cookies
Herbs like Rosemary for garnishing
Edible Flowers for decoration

Preparation

1 Pound the cookies till they become crumbs and set aside. 2 Scoop the ice cream into mini flower pots. If you do not have any, just use small plastic containers will do. See end of blog post in the link for another version…… 3 Top the ice-cream with cookie crumbs, and insert your choice of herbs into the dessert. 4 Place flowers or any edible stuff that resemble plants. You can get these edible flowers from any baking stores. 5 That’s it! You are all set to impress your guests with these Salted Caramel Potted Plant Ice Cream Desserts!

About

Let’s check out how easy it is to make these pretty edible plants!
